_note: Running log of adjudicated ground-truth values, keyed by pair_id. Filled in incrementally as the user reviews items; not yet complete for all 36.

_policy.tags_grading: Tags are graded on findability, not exact match: check itemName + brand + tags together as one pool. Pass if every 'required_terms' word appears somewhere in that pool (case-insensitive substring ok). Fail if any 'forbidden_terms' word appears anywhere in that pool, even if required terms are also present.
_policy.blank_vs_wrong: A blank/missing field is preferred over a wrong value — do not penalize abstaining as harshly as a confident wrong answer.
_policy.brand_365_canonicalization: For 365-brand items, any brand value containing '365' (regardless of 'by/By Whole Foods Market' suffix or casing) is acceptable.
_policy.brand_allowed_lists: Some items have brand ambiguity where multiple forms are legitimate (e.g. manufacturer vs. sub-brand). Use 'brand_allowed' list when present instead of a single string.
_policy.punctuation_insensitive_matching: required_terms/forbidden_terms matching should ignore punctuation (periods, apostrophes, hyphens) as well as case, e.g. 'Dr Pepper' should match 'Dr. Pepper', 'Annie's' should match 'Annies'.
_policy.size_qualifiers_in_itemName: When a pack's individual unit size differs from the standard/default size for that product (e.g. 'mini' cans vs standard cans, 'family size' vs standard box), and quantity/quantityUnits alone can't capture that distinction (e.g. quantity is reported as a pack count rather than volume), the size qualifier word should be required in itemName.
_policy.flavor_variants_not_graded: A wrong flavor/variant word within itemName (e.g. 'Sweet Chili' vs 'Nacho Cheese' for the same product line) is not counted as an error, since different flavors of the same item usually cost the same — only presence of required_terms/forbidden_terms and the other fields (brand, price, quantity) matter.
_policy.unit_equivalence: quantity/quantityUnits is graded correct if it numerically matches ground truth after converting within the same measurement family, not just on literal unit-string match (e.g. 64 fluid ounce == 0.5 gallon; 1 pound == 16 ounce). Volume family: fluid ounce, cup, pint, quart, gallon, liter, milliliter. Weight family: ounce, pound, gram, kilogram. Count-like units (count, package, pack, can, box) are NOT auto-interchangeable with each other or with volume/weight — those only match via an explicit quantity_allowed list.
